editor-overview.alt: The Vireo editor with preview, caption styles, transcript and timeline
editor-overview.caption: Find the preview in the centre, transcript on the right and timeline below.

layout-open.alt: Layout menu with scene and whole-clip scope
layout-open.caption: Choose the range before selecting a layout.

layout-scope.alt: This scene and Whole clip controls above layout choices
layout-scope.caption: This scene and Whole clip are separate controls.

layout-auto.alt: Auto layout option and eligible-layout explanation
layout-auto.caption: Auto is selected. Review the complete scene after choosing it.

reframe-on.alt: Auto Reframe ON and Apply to whole clip controls
reframe-on.caption: Auto Reframe is ON. Play the clip to review movement.

reframe-off.alt: Auto Reframe OFF with Held layout Fit
reframe-off.caption: OFF is shown alongside Held layout: Fit. Turning motion off is separate from choosing a layout.

reframe-scope.alt: Apply to whole clip beside the selected-item switch
reframe-scope.caption: The captured scope controls distinguish This video item from Apply to whole clip.

caption-inspector.caption: Typography contains the visible font, size, line and word-mode controls.

caption-modes.caption: Lines and Word Mode are separate controls. Check visible wrapping after either change.

caption-single-word.alt: Single word selected in Word Mode
caption-single-word.caption: Single word is selected. Review timing through a whole sentence.

caption-single-preview.caption: Single word shows one illustrative caption word at this moment.

caption-lines.caption: 2 Lines is selected. Check the actual line breaks in your own captions.

caption-lines-preview.alt: Short illustrative phrase on two visible lines
caption-lines-preview.caption: This short phrase fits two lines. Longer captions can wrap differently.

preview-selected.alt: Caption selected with corner handles in the preview
preview-selected.caption: The outline and corner handles identify the selected caption.

preview-position.alt: Caption after moving upward in the preview
preview-position.caption: The selected caption is higher than in the preceding image. The frame sequence below shows the intermediate states.
preview-position.videoLabel: Four chronological editor screenshots captured over 0.5 seconds, slowed to 2 seconds for reading. No cursor was captured; this is not a continuous screen recording.

preview-resize.alt: Caption Item Properties with Position X, Position Y, Scale and Opacity
preview-resize.caption: The captured inspector shows Position Y 756, Scale 1.00x and Opacity 100%. No resize is demonstrated.

canvas-ratio.alt: Square canvas with 1:1 ratio control above the preview
canvas-ratio.caption: The canvas is square in this captured state. Caption placement must be reviewed after a ratio change.

canvas-landscape.caption: Compare the same moment in a landscape canvas.

safe-guides.alt: Safe Zones ON and visible header and action-button guide regions
safe-guides.caption: Guides identify review areas, not a guarantee about every platform interface.

safe-guides-off.alt: Safe Zones OFF with guide overlays hidden
safe-guides-off.caption: The guide overlays are hidden in this captured state.

export-settings.alt: Export Video dialog with 720p selected and source-detail warning
export-settings.caption: 720p is selected. Check the source-detail warning before rendering. This lesson shows settings, not a completed download.

timeline-overview.alt: Timeline with selected video item and time ruler
timeline-overview.caption: The timeline before the edits. This example spans 12 seconds.

timeline-selected.alt: Selected video item with a white outline in the timeline
timeline-selected.caption: The selection outline identifies the video item, not the caption track.

timeline-trim.alt: Video item after its end was shortened
timeline-trim.caption: The video item ends earlier in this state. Review the caption and audio ranges separately.

timeline-trim-hint.alt: Restore trimmed end hint showing plus 1.4 seconds
timeline-trim-hint.caption: The transcript area offers Restore trimmed end (+1.4s). This is a reversible timeline trim, not automatic analysis.

timeline-split.alt: Two adjacent video items with the first selected
timeline-split.caption: The visible boundary divides the item near the playhead. It is an edit boundary, not an analysis scene marker.

timeline-duplicate.alt: Timeline with a duplicated short segment beside the first segment
timeline-duplicate.caption: A duplicated short segment is visible. Review subsequent items after any duplicate operation.

timeline-ripple.alt: Timeline after ripple delete with a shorter overall span
timeline-ripple.caption: The captured post-delete timeline is shorter. Check the new join and caption timing, rather than treating deletion as a local visual change.

transcript-edit.alt: Transcript sentence textarea with Cancel and Save
transcript-edit.caption: Edit the intended sentence, then review it against the audio.

transcript-word.alt: Save control below an editable transcript sentence
transcript-word.caption: Save applies the sentence edit. Listen again after changing the wording.

editor-save.alt: Green Saved indicator after reopening the separate restored fixture
editor-save.caption: Saved is shown after reopening this separate 12-second example.

saved-reframe-off.alt: Auto Reframe OFF retained in the reopened fixture
saved-reframe-off.caption: Auto Reframe remains OFF after reopening this example.

item-speed.alt: Video Item Properties with Speed set to 1x
item-speed.caption: The selected video item has its own Speed control. Preview playback settings are a different control.

caption-typography.alt: Typography before resizing, with font size 70
caption-typography.caption: Find font, size, weight and line settings in Typography.

caption-size-after.alt: Typography after resizing, with font size 95
caption-size-after.caption: The size is now 95. Recheck the caption position after resizing.

caption-resize-before.caption: Before the captured resize. Compare both text size and vertical placement.

caption-resize-after.alt: Larger caption after resizing and moving upward
caption-resize-after.caption: After the captured resize: larger text and a higher position. The anchor did not stay fixed.

caption-colours.alt: Effects panel with Active colour selected
caption-colours.caption: Active is selected with an orange swatch. Text, Active, Stroke and Box are different targets.

caption-highlight-preview.caption: VIVID is highlighted while CREATE stays visible. Play the sentence to check the timing.

caption-phrase.alt: Phrase plus highlight selected in Word Mode
caption-phrase.caption: Phrase + highlight keeps surrounding words visible. Lines is a separate choice.

correction-entered.caption: The revised wording is entered, ready to save.

correction-applied.alt: Rewritten sentence in the transcript after applying the edit
correction-applied.caption: The changed wording appears in the transcript. Recheck timing after a sentence rewrite.

correction-reopened.alt: Corrected text and adjusted duration after reopening
correction-reopened.caption: The corrected wording and 1.15-second duration remain after reopening.

word-timing-before.alt: Word Timing controls with start 1.20 and end 2.40 seconds
word-timing-before.caption: Before adjustment: start 1.20s, end 2.40s, duration 1200ms.

word-timing-adjusted.alt: Word Timing start adjusted to 1.25 seconds
word-timing-adjusted.caption: Start is now 1.25s and end remains 2.40s. The displayed duration is 1150ms.

word-timing-applied.alt: Transcript word showing the applied 1.15-second duration
word-timing-applied.caption: After Apply Word Timing, the badge shows 1.15s.

layout-fill.alt: Manual Fill with a tight crop of the speaker
layout-fill.caption: Fill makes a tighter view and can remove source detail at the sides. Inspect the actual result.

layout-blur.alt: Manual Blur with background and inset sharp region
layout-blur.caption: Blur changes the background treatment. Review the sharp region separately from the background.

layout-panels.alt: Manual Split with unassigned views on single-person footage
layout-panels.caption: This one-person example has unassigned views. Choose what each panel should show.

layout-three.alt: Manual Three layout with unassigned panels
layout-three.caption: Unassigned panels need deliberate setup. A multi-panel layout does not create additional camera views.

layout-whole-scope.alt: Layout menu with Whole clip scope selected
layout-whole-scope.caption: Whole clip is selected in this captured menu. Scope is separate from the layout choice.

tracker-scope.alt: Object tracker menu with scope choices
tracker-scope.caption: The tracker menu distinguishes this scene and whole clip. Check scope in the target picker before proceeding.

tracker-picker.alt: Object tracker selection dialog before Apply
tracker-picker.caption: The picker is open before a target is applied. No successful tracking run is demonstrated.

speed-before.caption: The selected item starts at 1x. This is an edit setting, not preview speed.

speed-after.caption: The selected video item is set to 1.5x.

speed-span.alt: Timeline after the 12-second item became 8 seconds
speed-span.caption: The timeline span is now 8 seconds rather than 12. Review captions, neighbouring items and sound.

speed-reopened.alt: Selected item speed 1.5x retained after reopening
speed-reopened.caption: The selected item remains at 1.5x after reopening.

lines-one-candidate.alt: Local candidate preview with one visible caption line
lines-one-candidate.caption: One visible line in this example. See the wrapping limitation below.

lines-two-candidate.alt: Local candidate preview with two visible caption lines
lines-two-candidate.caption: Two visible lines at the same moment. Check the complete sentence too.

lines-controls-candidate.alt: Candidate Lines controls with 2 Lines selected
lines-controls-candidate.caption: 2 Lines is selected under Typography & Layout.
